# Llama 3.2 3B Instruct

Meta · released 2024-09 · 3.21B params · llama3.2

Score within the [LMArena (text)](https://whatmodel.sh/?set=lmarena-text&score=set) comparison set only.

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

Workers plan fees excluded; billed in Neurons. Published USD rates are rounded. Product: Workers AI. API model: @cf/meta/llama-3.2-3b-instruct. Settings: plan=Workers Paid, free allocation=excluded, billing=published marginal USD rates; service bills Neurons. Currency: USD. · [context source](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/a668908cfe7073faa0363699486fc41a3ff52412/models/meta/llama-3.2-3b.toml)</sub>

<pre>
download         size  score
4-bit q4_k_m  ~2.43GB   36.1
8-bit q8_0    ~4.35GB   36.1
</pre>

```sh
# 4-bit q4_k_m
ollama run llama3.2:3b
# 8-bit q8_0
ollama run llama3.2:3b-instruct-q8_0
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
